target.title: fix(chutes): redact OAuth error response body
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readResponseTextLimited` + raw body in error for Chutes token exchange and
refresh non-2xx responses. The body text was embedded in the Error message.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaced with `extractProviderErrorDetail` for bounded, redacted structured
error detail. Removed now-unused `readResponseTextLimited` import and
`CHUTES_OAUTH_ERROR_BODY_LIMIT_BYTES` constant. Follows #102953.

## Evidence

### Targeted path proof (Chutes OAuth via extractProviderErrorDetail)

Real HTTP 400 with standard OAuth error body → `extractProviderErrorDetail(response)` in the exact exchangeChutesCodeForTokens/refreshChutesTokens pattern:

```
=== #103569 Proof: extractProviderErrorDetail on Chutes OAuth path ===
Status in message: PASS
Code in detail (redacted): PASS
Sensitive text redacted: PASS
Raw JSON keys not leaked: PASS
Structured [code=...] format: PASS
Detail bounded (65 chars): PASS

Message: Chutes token exchange failed with status 400: The access *** is invalid or has been revoked. [code=invalid_***]
Detail: The access *** is invalid or has been revoked. [code=invalid_***]

Overall: ALL PASS
```

### Import check

`node --import tsx` — import OK

### Diff

```
src/agents/chutes-oauth.ts | 16 ++++++-------
```

- [x] I understand what the code does
- [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns

@clawsweeper re-review
